basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Principal Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Industrial Research & Development Unit of the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) has announced 1 vacancy for the Principal Project Scientist post. This project-based position under advertisement number IITD/IRD/298/2026 is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay subject to periodic performance review, and renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier, with a consolidated fellowship / pay-slab of Rs. 75,600-77,870-80,210-82,620-85,100-87,650-90,280-92,900-95,780-98,650-1,01,610/- p.m. plus HRA @ 30%. how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec).

Submit it duly filled form with complete information regarding percentage of marks/division, details of work experience etc. by e-mail with advertisement No. on the subject line to Prof. Brejesh Lall at email id: [email protected].

The candidates who are interested to apply for the above post should download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec) of IIT Delhi and submit the duly filled form with complete information regarding percentage of marks/division, details of work experience etc. by e-mail with advertisement No. on the subject line to Prof. Brejesh Lall at email id: [email protected].
Submit the completed applications by e-mail within 15 days from publication (about 03/11/2026) by 5.00 p.m.
important_instructions: A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to the SC/ST Candidates. In case of selection of a retired/superannuated government employee, his/her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms. In case any clarification is required on eligibility regarding the above post, the candidate may contact to Prof. Brejesh Lall at email ID: [email protected]. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post under the project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the specific educational and experiential requirements outlined for the project post.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree in the appropriate discipline OR M. Tech. 1st class or equivalent OR M.Sc. in science or Engineering or MS(R) or equivalent (MA/MCom/MDes) with 10 years experience.
rows.desirable_qualification: Hands-on experience in sensing and wireless communication.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Appointment shall be on contractual basis with consolidated pay subject to periodic performance review, and renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. The consolidated fellowship / pay-slab is Rs. 75,600-77,870-80,210-82,620-85,100-87,650-90,280-92,900-95,780-98,650-1,01,610/- p.m. plus HRA @ 30%.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for shortlisting of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project post and their name will be displayed on web link (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted) alongwith the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview.
